children.value: > Fact From Story Epic wants ultimately is free competition and fair competition for everybody, and the removal of the payments tie and removal of the anticompetitive measures, which obviously leads to far better deals for consumers and developers.

> > Fact From Story What we don’t want is a special deal just for ourselves, and Google’s strategy so far as you’ve seen from all these deals has been to basically take out all their potential competitors one at a time while they’re still weak and small, before they build up or unite into a formidable force.
> > > Fact From Story Epic's not going to go along with something like that and do a special deal just for ourselves.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Epic wants to compete fairly with Google.
